conflicts.summary: Global Command + Y remap replaces app-specific Command + Y behavior, including Chrome History.
conflicts.evidence: Karabiner rule has no app conditions; Chrome documents Command + Y for History.
conflicts.recommendedNonDestructiveTest: Open Karabiner-EventViewer, press Command + Y in Chrome, and confirm the emitted Command + Shift + Z without changing settings.

conflicts.summary: Hammerspoon swallows raw Command-scroll and emits keyboard zoom chords instead.
conflicts.evidence: The eventtap callback returns true after posting Command + = or Command + -.
conflicts.recommendedNonDestructiveTest: Test Command-scroll in one browser and one document app while watching Hammerspoon Console events.

conflicts.summary: BetterStage blocks default middle click when opening its Snap Wheel.
conflicts.evidence: snapWheelTriggers sets mouseButton 2 and blockDefaultClick true.
conflicts.recommendedNonDestructiveTest: Middle-click a browser link and confirm BetterStage opens the wheel instead of the background tab.
